role: Expert vector designer and technical art director
selection: Accept the first candidate that passes every predeclared original control. If neither passes, do not activate a semantic reward.
controls: 17 original fixtures created without purchased references or existing candidate outputs; 14 Jev decisions and 3 deterministic artifact failures.
expectations: Stored before inference in calibration/coordinator-only.json; never sent to Jev.
batching: One complete drawing per request, concurrency three. No cross-item batching without separate calibration.
aggregation: Use native score expectations, weights 35/25/20/20, critical missing-brief cap 0.49. Confidence is separate.
freeze: Freeze the selected rubric, job, implementation, fonts, runner, controls and observed model before current-output scoring.
retrospective_scope: All 18 baseline b and all 18 current q public svp3 outputs. No private cases, reference SVGs, old scores or treatment names enter Jev state.
limitations: A small synthetic calibration tests concrete failure sensitivity and attainability, not general expert reliability. Text-only source reasoning is not direct visual perception. No skill promotion follows from this public retrospective.
